pretreatment: sputtering with 3 keV Ar+ with a total dose 1 × 1017 ions/cm 2, then calcined at 500°C for 30 min
evidence: Small pure A1 disks were cleaned and mounted in the NODUS set-up. After sputtering with 3 keV Ar + with a total dose 1 × 1017 ions/cm 2, the LEIS spectrum showed a clean surface with only an aluminum peak. Next the substrate was transferred to the preparation chamber of the NODUS and calcined at 500°C for 30 min.
